posts.title: A 2008 State of Mind
posts.description: Lately, the enthusiast discourse around game consoles and adjacent hardware has had me rubbing my eyes and checking the calendar. What year is it? Why are we talking about PlayStation, Xbox, or even the Steam Machine as if the games industry got trapped in a time vortex, perpetually stuck in 2008? I understand the temptation. posts.title: On Break
posts.description: Between work and school, I have a unusually heavy workload that necessitates putting a pause on all my projects until the end of this semester. I will still support Konga Beat and Konga Launcher with bug fixes as needed, but everything else is on hold until May. See you folks then!

posts.title: What Remains of Xbox
